steps.title: Configure project package and build configuration
steps.description: Configure Gradle build settings, target SDK 34, compile SDK 34, and Temurin 17 Java 8 source compatibility for LockPlayTube.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest and app permissions
steps.description: Declare foreground service media playback, internet access, wake lock, post notifications permissions, and activity components in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Define backend schema and app identity metadata
steps.description: Configure api_schema.json and app-meta.json for offline backend capability and app identification.

steps.title: Define application UI colors, strings, and theme styles
steps.description: Set up UI color palette, dark mode styles, and string resources across strings.xml, colors.xml, and styles.xml.

steps.title: Create layout drawables and vector icons
steps.description: Create custom vector drawables for playback controls, navigation toolbar buttons, container cards, and action layouts.

steps.title: Build watch history XML activity and item layouts
steps.description: Define activity_history.xml and item_history.xml layouts for history list management and item row interactions.

steps.title: Design main WebView container layout with paywall screen
steps.description: Build activity_main.xml layout containing main WebView component, top navigation bar, network error state container, and full-screen paywall overlay.

steps.title: Implement HistoryItem model data structure
steps.description: Create HistoryItem class to store video playback record attributes such as ID, title, URL, and timestamp.

steps.title: Implement SQLite database helper for watch history management
steps.description: Develop HistoryDbHelper for managing local SQLite storage, storing play records, querying history lists, and clearing history entries.

steps.title: Implement watch history list adapter
steps.description: Build HistoryAdapter to bind watch history records to ListView items and handle delete actions.

steps.title: Implement background audio playback service with media session
steps.description: Implement BackgroundAudioService using MediaSession, wake locks, audio focus management, and foreground notification transport controls.

steps.title: Implement paywall and device ID license manager
steps.description: Create TrialPaywallManager to verify access status, generate unique device ID, retrieve admin payment configs, and manage plan verification.

steps.title: Implement watch history activity view controller
steps.description: Develop HistoryActivity to render watch history items, dispatch selected video URLs back to main player, and confirm clearing history.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity with JavaScript audio bridge and lock screen control
steps.description: Construct MainActivity to initialize WebView settings, inject background audio JS scripts, bridge media playback state to service, and enforce lock paywall overlay.

steps.title: Building LockPlayTube
steps.description: Compile and assemble the final LockPlayTube application package.
